description: Consumer Airfare Report: Table 2 - Top 1,000 City-Pair Markets is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Aviation", published or maintained by Department of Transportation Office of the Assistant Secretary for Aviation and International Affairs. Data summarized by city, includes the number of city-pair markets in the top 1,000 in either comparison period that involve each city, the number of passengers traveling to and from each city, the average fare, average fare per mile (yield), and average distance traveled. All records are aggregated as directionless city pair markets. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Aviation". It has 21 columns, among them Year, Geocoded_City (zip), Geocoded_City (state), ly_yield, ly_passengers, distance. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last data update. Attribution given: Department of Transportation Office of the Assistant Secretary for Aviation and International Affairs. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
